# Teach detail: 'summary' and agentIdentity on query_raw_memories sweeps in seat memory and skills

## Context

Follow-up leaf to `neomjs/neo-agent-brain#1280` (`PR #1288`), requested in Cycle-1 review (`pullrequestreview-5646779645` [QUARANTINED_URL: github.com] `RA-5` by `@neo-opus-ada`) and grounded in `neomjs/neo` Discussion `#20111` (comment `19184520` [QUARANTINED_URL: github.com], dispositioned by `@neo-fable-clio` in `comment 19184558` [QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]).

## The Problem

`neomjs/neo-agent-brain#1280` (`PR #1288`) adds `agentIdentity`, `detail: 'summary' | 'full'`, and `projection: 'public' | 'private'` to `query_raw_memories` (and `agentIdentity` to `query_summaries`), keeping `detail: 'full'` as the default on `query_raw_memories` so existing callers and unit specs remain 100% backward compatible.

However, keeping `detail: 'full'` as the default means the 30k–80k char context-window savings only materialize when agents and skills pass `detail: 'summary'` during discovery sweeps and reserve `detail: 'full'` for hydrating specific hits. Today, three instruction surfaces still point at `query_raw_memories` without `detail: 'summary'`:
1. `ai/services/fleet/seatMemoryLayerTemplate.mjs:99-100` (in `neomjs/neo-agent-brain`), which renders the hot-index header for generated seat memory layers (`> archive (query_raw_memories semantic, query_recent_turns recency).`).
2. `.agents/skills/memory-mining/references/memory-mining-protocol.md` (`lines 38-40` in `neomjs/neo-agent-skills` / mirrored to `neomjs/neo`), which instructs agents to run `query_raw_memories` first on recent/active-session investigations without specifying `detail: 'summary'` for the initial sweep vs `detail: 'full'` for hit hydration.
3. `AGENTS.md §verify_before_assert` (`Prior-art sweep` paragraph), which prescribes a 3–10-call `query_raw_memories` / `query_summaries` sweep without noting `detail: 'summary'`.

## The Architectural Reality

- `ai/services/fleet/seatMemoryLayerTemplate.mjs` (`395` LOC in `neomjs/neo-agent-brain`):
  - Line `100` renders the `MEMORY.md` header note pointing to `query_raw_memories` and `query_recent_turns`.
  - `test/playwright/unit/ai/services/fleet/SeatMemoryLayer.spec.mjs` tests the rendered template output.
- `.agents/skills/memory-mining/references/memory-mining-protocol.md` (canonical in `neomjs/neo-agent-skills`, synced to `neomjs/neo`):
  - `§2 Tool order by freshness` (`lines 34-42`) defines when to call `query_raw_memories` vs `query_summaries`.
- `AGENTS.md §verify_before_assert` (governed by `learn/agentos/decisions/0007-agents-md-compaction-taxonomy.md` and `turn-memory-pre-flight` net-zero/negative loaded-byte budget).

Structure map (`npm run ai:structure-map -- --files --loc` run `2026-10-26T02:43Z`): `ai/services/fleet/seatMemoryLayerTemplate.mjs` owns the Brain-side seat memory template; skill and `AGENTS.md` updates belong to `neomjs/neo-agent-skills` / `neomjs/neo`.

## The Fix

1. **In `neomjs/neo-agent-brain` (`ai/services/fleet/seatMemoryLayerTemplate.mjs`):**
   - Update the Memory Core pointer in `renderMemoryIndex` (`line 100`) and `renderAboutThisLayer` (`lines 128-175`) so generated seat memory layers teach `query_raw_memories({ query, detail: 'summary' })` (and optional `agentIdentity` / `memorySharing: 'team'`) for discovery sweeps, followed by targeted `detail: 'full'` (or `projection: 'public'`) hydration on matching hits.
   - Update `test/playwright/unit/ai/services/fleet/SeatMemoryLayer.spec.mjs` if assertions match the exact template string.
2. **In `neomjs/neo-agent-skills` (mirrored to `neomjs/neo`):**
   - Update `.agents/skills/memory-mining/references/memory-mining-protocol.md` `§2 Tool order by freshness` to teach the two-step pattern: run `query_raw_memories({ query, detail: 'summary' })` (and `agentIdentity` when author-scoped) for the 2–4 discovery sweeps, then hydrate only relevant hits with `detail: 'full'` (`projection: 'public'` for cross-seat team reads).
   - If `AGENTS.md §verify_before_assert` is touched, obey `0007-agents-md-compaction-taxonomy.md` (`turn-memory-pre-flight`) so total loaded bytes do not increase.

## Contract Ledger Matrix

| Target Surface | Source of Authority | Proposed Behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ai/services/fleet/seatMemoryLayerTemplate.mjs` (`lines 99-100, 128-175`) | `neomjs/neo-agent-brain#1280` (`PR #1288`) + Discussion `#20111` Option F | Teaches `detail: 'summary'` (and `agentIdentity`) on `query_raw_memories` discovery sweeps before `detail: 'full'` hydration | Existing `MEMORY.md` files remain valid | `seatMemoryLayerTemplate.mjs` JSDoc + rendered markdown | `SeatMemoryLayer.spec.mjs` unit test |
| `memory-mining-protocol.md` `§2` (`neomjs/neo-agent-skills`) | `neomjs/neo-agent-brain#1280` (`PR #1288`) | Prescribes `detail: 'summary'` on initial `query_raw_memories` sweeps and targeted `detail: 'full'` on hits | Default `detail: 'full'` remains backward-compatible in `MemoryService` | Skill markdown | `npm test` in `neomjs/neo-agent-skills` |

## Decision Record impact

`aligned-with` `learn/agentos/decisions/0007-agents-md-compaction-taxonomy.md` — any `AGENTS.md` touch must stay net-neutral or net-negative in loaded bytes; primary procedural detail lives in `seatMemoryLayerTemplate.mjs` and `memory-mining-protocol.md`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `ai/services/fleet/seatMemoryLayerTemplate.mjs` teaches `detail: 'summary'` (and `agentIdentity`) on `query_raw_memories` discovery sweeps, with `SeatMemoryLayer.spec.mjs` passing.
- [ ] `memory-mining-protocol.md` (`§2 Tool order by freshness`) teaches `detail: 'summary'` for initial `query_raw_memories` sweeps and `detail: 'full'` (`projection: 'public'` for cross-seat reads) for hit hydration.

## Out of Scope

- Changing `query_raw_memories`'s schema default from `detail: 'full'` to `detail: 'summary'` (intentionally kept `'full'` in `#1280` to preserve backward compatibility for existing callers/tests).

## Avoided Traps

- **Bloating `AGENTS.md` loaded byte count:** Detailed parameter guidance belongs in `memory-mining-protocol.md` and `seatMemoryLayerTemplate.mjs`, not in turn-loaded `AGENTS.md` prose (`ADR-0007`).
